title: Memory Fabric provider and block identity
summary: Memory Fabric keeps stable fabric/MU/MI identity separate from provider incarnation and transport endpoint. Job-to-Node retains placement authority.
invariants: A provider epoch and providerGeneration fence old offers; a service registration and raw XTP ACK are not proofs of current memory ownership.

MemoryFabricRegistry~resolveBlock(blockId,generation) identifies one presently authoritative block owner; a different provider claiming a resident replica requires independent authenticated replica authority.
Resident block offset/length and page-aligned window checks precede transfer admission, and are repeated before send.
No transparent remote memory pointers: move work toward resident memory when placement admits it; use shared/DMA block bag locally.

provenance.claim: Defines provider identities, epochs, block reference and resolveBlock current-authority semantics.
Defines native block-bag seam and block lifetime semantics.
